messages:
maria: Heads-up — thinking about per-route saved filters for Console analytics. Need the view to show model-level breakdowns + routing policy and quota hints. Anyone free to sync? TL;DR: saved queries should persist route+model filters and optionally surface routing/quota suggestions.

leon: +1. We need to decide if saved query stores `routing_hint` in the API or only in the UI. Storing it in the API complicates versioning and rollout. Maybe store metadata separately and keep core `filters` stable. :thinking_face:

sam: From DevEx POV users expect copyable share links that reproduce routing/fallbacks. Also want the saved query to include a suggested `fallback_model` and an optional `cost_estimate`. :bulb:

anya: UX idea: show a tiny badge on saved queries: "quota-sensitive" and show estimated unit cost + top token contributor on hover. If a `routing_hint` exists, show a pill like `route → model` that can be edited inline. Keep the main saved view compact.

maria: Good. Question: should the saved query API be backward compatible so older clients ignore unknown metadata fields?

leon: Absolutely. API must be tolerant. Proposed schema (rough):
```json
{
  "filters": [...],
  "metadata": {
    "routing_hint": "gpt-4o-small",
    "fallback_model": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "quota_policy_hint": "reserve_10pct"
  }
}
```

sam: That `quota_policy_hint` is useful. Console can show suggested autoscale and dedicated capacity warnings if the saved query historically spikes cost or hits quota. We should show a small tooltip: `expected cost per 1k tokens: X` and an option to attach a budget alert.

console-bot: deploy: saved-queries-service v2 deployed to staging by @infra-ci at 2024-06-15T14:12Z :rocket:

anya: Quick mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/per-route-saved-query — includes badge states, cost preview on hover, and inline pill editor.

maria: Next steps: Leon -> draft API patch & open PR, Sam -> add share-link + cost preview behavior, Anya -> final mocks + microcopy. Sync tomorrow 10am? @leon @sam @anya

leon: I'll open PR by EOD and add schema docs. :thumbsup:

sam: Adding test plan and telemetry hooks to the doc, will ping QA and SRE for quota signals.

anya: Will add microcopy for pill states and the hover cost tooltip.

maria: Thanks all — adding to roadmap and noting rollout phasing (staged: staging flags -> canary -> GA). :tada:
